Discussion: https://github.com/tiangolo/fastapi/discussions/9744

This is because `inspect.unwrap()` is used in `Dependant` (in `fastapi/dependencies/models.py`) but `partial` objects are not automatically unwrapped by `inspect.unwrap` in a way that allows `inspect.iscoroutinefunction` or `inspect.isgeneratorfunction` to correctly identify the underlying wrapped function.

CHANGE: Modify `_unwrapped_call` in `Dependant` class to recursively unwrap `functools.partial` objects by accessing their `.func` attribute.
